notes.title: The Very first Update!
notes.content:
Changes:

Changed the lightning in the First few areas as it was too dark!

Added Pop Up in the beginning hinting at the inventory!

Added Weapon Recoil!



Small Bugfixes in the Background.



I thank everyone who already played the Humble Demo! it is a new journey for me as i never developed before and i am looking forward to what is to come!
